portfolio.aboutIntro: I'm {{name}}, a Full-Stack Developer based in {{location}}. I started programming around 2021. Today, I build business websites and small web apps for freelance clients, alongside my work at TeamSystem.
portfolio.background: My work ranges from a client business website to a local Go terminal assistant. I like turning a practical problem into something people can use, then explaining the decisions behind it.
portfolio.quality: I care about clear interfaces, predictable behavior, and a handoff that makes the project easy to understand.
portfolio.experience: I contribute to an internal Backoffice tool for support and operators, covering company and document validation, email workflows, user administration, roles, and permissions. I work with three other developers and a Product Owner; my contribution is roughly 90% frontend and 10% backend. On the frontend, I use React, TanStack Router, Query and Store, Playwright E2E, and Bun and Jest unit testing.

rite-electric.description: A multipage business website for Rite Electric, built from design through implementation.
rite-electric.problem: Give the business a website that presents its services and client-supplied photos.
rite-electric.contribution: I designed and built the whole site. The client supplied the photos and approved my design and implementation decisions.
rite-electric.decisions: I used a multipage structure with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
rite-electric.evidence: The live website shows the delivered work. The client gave very positive feedback on quality and value.

junior-assistant.description: An offline macOS terminal assistant in Go for finding files and tracking tasks, bugs, and next steps.
junior-assistant.problem: Resume interrupted debugging without losing the facts learned or the next step to try.
junior-assistant.contribution: I developed the entire tool, including file search, task and bug tracking, and the today view.
junior-assistant.decisions: Explicit commands and manually entered progress notes keep behavior predictable. The runtime stays local: no AI, telemetry, cloud integration, or background service.
junior-assistant.evidence: Public source and the command walkthrough below show the workflow. The repository records macOS arm64 V1 acceptance checks; no binary release is published.

portfolio.description: The full-stack site you are reading, with a blog, reader interactions, and an admin dashboard.
portfolio.problem: Present my work and publish writing with a place for reader discussion.
portfolio.contribution: I built the portfolio and its publishing and reader workflows.
portfolio.decisions: TanStack Start connects the UI and server functions; Drizzle and PostgreSQL store content, BetterAuth handles sign-in, and Cloudflare R2 stores uploads.
portfolio.evidence: Explore the blog and public source for the implementation.
